name: sootsayer-morning-brief
description: Every morning at 06:00 WIB, a Kiro Crew agent asks the Sootsayer engine where wildfire haze will hit Indonesia's puskesmas over the next five days and delivers the health-office briefing word for word, with its 95% ranges, haze-day chances, data times and method limits.
author: maulanawirawan
highlights: A 06:00 WIB schedule (Asia/Jakarta) that runs the sootsayer-morning-briefer agent; it ships paused until you set it up
Briefings written by the Sootsayer Rust engine, not by the model: the agent forwards them word for word
Every estimate keeps its 95% range, every haze-day chance its source and test, and every failed source is named
Kalimantan and Sumatra's peatland provinces, in Bahasa Indonesia or English
Seven read-only Sootsayer MCP tools, approved for unattended runs: priority, haze_outlook, clinic_plan, daily_brief, forecast_check, list_regions, list_districts
useCases: When the haze season starts, resume the morning-brief schedule so the sootsayer-morning-briefer agent delivers each day's briefing for Kalimantan and Sumatra at 06:00 WIB
When a district office asks where to open posko or oxygen houses this week, ask the sootsayer-morning-briefer agent for the priority and watch lists with their 95% ranges and chances
When a puskesmas head plans a clean-air waiting room, ask the sootsayer-morning-briefer agent, which follows the haze-morning-brief skill, for that clinic's plan
When someone asks how far to trust the forecast, have the sootsayer-morning-briefer agent quote forecast_check with its counts and caveats instead of a guess
configuration: Clone https://github.com/maulanawirawan/sootsayer and build the engine once: cargo build --release --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml
Set the environment variable SOOTSAYER_REPO to that clone (for example D:\github\sootsayer) before starting Kiro Crew; uv must be on PATH
Install and enable the app (trust it when asked), then resume the morning-brief schedule on the Schedule page and choose where its result is delivered

crons.name: morning-brief
crons.message: Morning briefing run. For each region in turn, kalimantan then sumatra: call daily_brief with mode "live" and lang "id", and copy its text field exactly, without changing a word or a number. Under each briefing add one line that names the region and the data times the tool reported, and say plainly if the tool reported a failed source. If daily_brief fails, report the error and the region; never write a briefing yourself.
